_dataGroups_note: Audit A-11 / P-9: the service worker used to cache every /api/v1/** response
(matters, clients with PAN/GSTIN, documents, messages) in the browser's
Cache Storage for an hour — readable after logout and by anyone with the
device. No API response is cached any more: every /api/v1 route, including
the news feed, requires a signed-in user (CurrentUserDep) and there is no
unauthenticated reference API — the statutory library is served as static
files under /bare-acts/** and stays cached via the asset group above.
If a genuinely public, tenant-independent read is added later, give it its
own `freshness` group with maxAge <= 10m here; never add /api/v1/** back.
